title: Getting ready for winter: who is offered which vaccination
excerpt: Vaccination clinics run every Tuesday and Thursday afternoon from October. Who is invited, what to bring and how long it takes.
content:
From October, vaccination clinics run every Tuesday and Thursday afternoon. You do not need to see a doctor first; a nurse will go through a short list of questions with you.

Who is invited

Invitations follow the national recommendations for the season, which change from year to year. If you are not sure whether you are included, ask at reception or call us.

What to bring

  • Your vaccination record, if you have one
  • Your insurance card
  • A short-sleeved top

Allow twenty minutes, including the wait afterwards. Appointments can be made by telephone.

This article is general information and not personal medical advice. If you are worried about your health, please make an appointment.
